message.content:
Based on my research, I can now estimate how many times the average human blinks in a lifetime. Let me walk through the calculation:

## Key Statistics from Research

**Blink Rate:**
- Most adults blink about **14-17 times per minute** (Cleveland Clinic)
- Other sources cite **15-20 times per minute** as the average
- Research studies show an average spontaneous eye blink rate of about **13.8 blinks per minute**

**Daily Blink Count:**
- At 14-17 blinks/minute while awake for 16 hours: **13,440 to 16,320 blinks per day** (Cleveland Clinic)
- At 15 blinks/minute for 16 hours awake: about **14,400 blinks per day**
- Some sources estimate higher, around **21,600 blinks per day** (assuming blinking continues at the same rate throughout all waking hours)

**Average Lifespan:**
- WHO estimates average global life expectancy at approximately **72-73 years**
- In developed countries, average lifespan is closer to **78-80 years**

## Calculation

Using conservative, well-supported estimates:

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Blink rate | 15 blinks/minute |
| Hours awake per day | 16 hours |
| Minutes awake per day | 960 minutes |
| **Blinks per day** | **14,400 blinks** |
| Days per year | 365.25 (including leap years) |
| **Blinks per year** | **~5.26 million blinks** |
| Average lifespan | 75 years |
| **Total lifetime blinks** | **~394 million blinks** |

Using slightly different assumptions:
- At 17 blinks/minute × 960 minutes × 365.25 days × 75 years = **~447 million blinks**
- At 15 blinks/minute for 18 hours awake × 365.25 × 75 years = **~443 million blinks**

## Conclusion

The average human blinks approximately **400 to 500 million times in a lifetime**. 

A commonly cited rounded estimate is about **420 million to 620 million blinks** over a lifetime, depending on:
- Exact blink rate (varies by individual, activity, and environment)
- Hours spent awake
- Overall lifespan
- Whether you count only waking hours or include blinking during sleep (minimal)

For a quick memorable number: **about half a billion blinks** in an average lifetime.

Sources:
1. https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/blinking
2. https://www.allaboutvision.com/eye-care/eye-anatomy/how-many-times-we-blink-per-day/
3. https://www.sciencetimes.com/articles/47349/20231128/why-blink-what-eyes-frequency-considered-normal.htm
4. https://wellwisp.com/how-many-times-should-you-blink-per-minute/
5. https://www.researchgate.net/publication/6698893_Further_Analysis_of_the_Human_Spontaneous_Eye_Blink_Rate_by_a_Cluster_Analysis-Based_Approach_to_Categorize_Individuals_With_Normal_Versus_Frequent_Eye_Blink_Activity
6. https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2402.12280
7. https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12280v2
8. https://www.londonvisionclinic.com/blink-and-youll-feel-better/

10. https://www.oscarwylee.com.au/glasses/how-many-times-do-you-blink-a-day
